scope: Synthetic namespace migration from a Baseline-compatible admission state through Restricted audit/warn to Restricted enforcement, using server dry-run probes, matching audit annotations and one benign compliant live Pod. Legacy inventory and disablement, system scope, custom PSP features, namespace permission governance and the actual workload upgrade require deployment evidence.

checks.claim: Kubernetes v1.36 discovery and direct lookup confirm PSP is not served

observed.direct_lookup: error: the server doesn't have a resource type "podsecuritypolicies"

checks.claim: Baseline admits the harmless Pod that omits Restricted-only settings
Restricted audit/warn stage admits the same request and returns a Restricted warning

observed.warning: Warning: would violate PodSecurity "restricted:v1.36": allowPrivilegeEscalation != false (container "probe" must set securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false), unrestricted capabilities (container "probe" must set securityContext.capabilities.drop=["ALL"])

checks.claim: Restricted enforcement denies the identical request with a PSA reason
checks.observed: Error from server (Forbidden): error when creating "STDIN": pods "saf-0301-003-restricted-dry-run" is forbidden: violates PodSecurity "restricted:v1.36": allowPrivilegeEscalation != false (container "probe" must set securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false), unrestricted capabilities (container "probe" must set securityContext.capabilities.drop=["ALL"])

checks.claim: Compliant Restricted Pod is admitted without a Restricted violation warning
checks.observed: server dry-run accepted without PSA warning
